address: King Edward's Parade, Eastbourne, East Sussex,BN21 4EE
bio: The Lansdowne Hotel is a charming, family-run, hotel situated on the seafront at Eastbourne, with Beachy Head, the South Downs and Brighton all within easy reach.  The hotel has a cosy atmosphere and sea views that stretch across the south coast, providing the perfect haven for a traditional Afternoon Tea in Eastbourne.  Afternoon Tea is served in the well-appointed lounges, two of which offer a sea view. Enjoy a selection of finger sandwiches and fruit or scones with clotted cream - all served with a pot of tea and coffee. An additional third lounge is pet-friendly, so you can bring your beloved dog with you to relax.
